name: Courage
description: Fear is real, but so is the God who walks with you. Laugh through fear charades, learn from Bible heroes, and practice small acts of boldness together.

cards.title: Be Strong
cards.prompt: Read it like a sports commentator, then say what 'be strong' means to you.
cards.body: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

cards.title: I Am With You
cards.prompt: Name one fear that fits under this verse. The group answers together: 'God is with you.'
cards.body: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

cards.title: Whom Shall I Fear?
cards.prompt: Rewrite this verse as a one-line text to a friend who is scared.
cards.body: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

cards.title: Power, Love, Sound Mind
cards.prompt: Share one situation this week where you need power, love, or a sound mind.
cards.body: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

cards.title: I Will Trust
cards.prompt: Explain this verse to the group using only 5 words.
cards.body: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

cards.prompt: What's the silliest thing you were afraid of as a kid?
What's the bravest thing you've ever done?
Where is it hardest to stand for your faith: school, work, friends, or online? Why?
What do you do when you feel afraid? Does it help?
What would you do for God if you knew you couldn't fail?
What does 'even if He doesn't' (Daniel 3:18) look like in your life?

cards.title: Boldest Prayer
cards.prompt: Pray out loud for the person on your left, even if it's just one sentence.

cards.title: New Face
cards.prompt: Greet someone you haven't met yet today, in person or by message, and ask how you can pray for them.

cards.title: Speak Up
cards.prompt: Share one thing you're proud of about your faith in under 30 seconds.

cards.title: Fear Out Loud
cards.prompt: Say one fear out loud and let the group pray one sentence over it.

cards.title: Stand Tall
cards.prompt: Stand up, take a deep breath, and read Joshua 1:9 aloud with confidence.

cards.title: Fear Charades
cards.prompt: Act out common fears such as exams, public speaking, bugs, and the dark, without speaking.
cards.instruction: One person acts while the team guesses. Most correct in the time wins.

cards.title: Trust Walk
cards.prompt: One player closes their eyes and is guided around a course by a teammate's voice alone. Then swap.
cards.instruction: Clear the path first and keep it safe. Walk slowly. No running.

cards.title: Fearless Facts
cards.prompt: List as many Bible heroes who faced fear as you can: David, Esther, Daniel, Gideon, Moses...
cards.instruction: Teams write names. Most correct names wins.

cards.title: Even If Relay
cards.prompt: Each player finishes the sentence: 'Even if ..., I will trust God.'
cards.instruction: The first team to have every player finish a sentence wins.

cards.prompt: Share a time you were afraid and God showed up.
Tell about a time you stood for what's right when it was hard.
Share an answered prayer that took courage to ask.
Tell about someone whose courage inspired your faith.
